name: Dynatrace Transactions
description: names Dynatrace transactions/traces by route path, entity bundle and highest-weight user role, exposing the name through a service method Dynatrace captures as a request attribute.
project_description: A port of the New Relic Transactions module adapted for Dynatrace. It renames each request's transaction/trace using the route path template (with entity-type route parameters replaced by the entity bundle) plus the current user's highest-weight role, e.g. "node/{article} (editor)". Dynatrace has no PHP extension, so instead of calling an extension function the module hands the computed name to a plain PHP method (TransactionNamer::setTransactionName). Dynatrace's OneAgent is configured (on the Dynatrace side) to capture that method argument as a request attribute, which can then be used to name the trace. The only release published is 1.0.0-rc2, a pre-release on the 1.0.x branch; there is no stable release and the project is not covered by Drupal's security advisory policy.
